        <p>Yes. Kinesis currency holders are fully entitled to redeem the underlying gold and silver bullion that underpins Kinesis gold (KAU) and silver (KAG) currencies, subject to minimum withdrawal requirements.</p><p>Kinesis currencies are allocated 1:1 with investment grade, allocated physical precious metal. This is confirmed semi-annually via an independent professional audit.</p><p><em>You can find all Kinesis audit reports up to date </em><a href="https://kinesis.money/audits/" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer"><em>here</em></a><em>. </em></p><p> </p><p>We provide redemption of the underlying bullion using logistic partners, Loomis and Brinks.</p><p>Redeeming bullion simultaneously destroys the digital representation of the bullion and removes the respective currency from circulation.</p><p><em>You can find Kinesis redemption fees listed </em><a href="https://kinesis.money/about-us/fees/#physical-redemption-fees" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer"><em>here</em></a><em>. </em></p>
